uncited: It addresses the problem of balancing visual fidelity with performance, specifically by accelerating opacity evaluation and enabling real-time parameter modification [S1, S2].
Early methods relied on pre-computed 1D LUTs stored in texture memory [S3, S6].
The introduction of programmable shaders enabled real-time modification of illumination parameters [S1].
Optimization techniques like the min-max octree and SAT were developed to address the computational cost of evaluating opacity functions for every sample, particularly in shear-warp rendering [S1].
